description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ferocious Pup, adding {C}{C}.
When Ferocious Pup dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Ferocious Pup from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ferocious Pup enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
